t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Select Green, yellow, orange and blue gnomes until you get around 2/3. After that you start selecting the GYOB gnomes and they will increase your amount by taking you to a different area of the forest. You need to pay attention and keep your hands on the keyboard

vb_textbox.text: Select the green, red, orange and blue gnomes, they will give you the highest yield. Once you are in a pattern switch to the opposite colours as you will eventually go down to 0 points on those ones. Concentrate on selecting the correct colours and sticking to them
